 Palo Alto Earnings Boost Cybersecurity Sentiment: Zscaler Stock Gains
 2 min read ZS PANW NVDA Zscaler, Inc. ZS stock extended gains in Thursday’s premarket session as expectations of higher cybersecurity spending and strong earnings from industry peer Palo Alto Networks Inc. www.benzinga.com/quote/PANW PANW lifted investor sentiment . 
 The rally also follows heightened concerns about digital infrastructure security, growing demand for AI protection and NVIDIA Corp.’s www.benzinga.com/quote/NVDA NVDA quarterly earnings beat. 
 Palo Alto Earnings Beat Signals Strong Cybersecurity Demand 
 Palo Alto reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $3.45 billion, up 39% year over year and above estimates of $3.31 billion. Adjusted EPS of $1.05 also topped expectations . 
 Next-generation security annual recurring revenue surged 66% to $9.73 billion, while remaining performance obligations reached $21 billion. 
 Chairman and CEO Nikesh Arora said companies were tapping "emergency funds" for AI defense . 
 "You’ll see cyber budgets rise, I’m sure, in the next two years," Arora said, adding that critical and severe vulnerabilities were being discovered at nearly seven times last year’s monthly average. 
 Technology Outages Put Cybersecurity Stocks in Focus 
 Recent outages affecting Microsoft systems and critical infrastructure have drawn attention to digital resilience, although the disruptions have not been established as connected cyberattacks. 
 ZS Earnings Preview: December 2026 Estimates and Analyst Targets 
 The countdown is on: Zscaler is set to report earnings on December 2, 2026 (confirmed). 
 EPS Estimate : $1.16 (Up from 96 cents YoY) 
 Revenue Estimate : $937.69 million (Up from $788.10 million YoY) 
 Analyst Consensus & Recent Actions: The stock carries a Buy rating with an average price forecast of $244.93 (high: $305.00; low: $175.00) across 50 analysts. Recent analyst moves include: 
 Freedom Broker : Buy (Raises Target to $270.00) (Oct. 22) 
 DA Davidson : Initiated with Neutral (Target $215.00) (Oct. 21) 
 Citigroup : Buy (Raises Target to $260.00) (Oct. 15) 
 Zscaler Edge Rankings: Momentum Score and Trading Takeaways 
 Below is the Benzinga Edge scorecard for Zscaler, highlighting its strengths and weaknesses compared to the broader market: 
 Momentum : Neutral (Score: 39.85) — The stock’s recent trend is mixed, suggesting it may need stronger follow-through to stand out versus the broader market. 
 The Verdict: Zscaler’s Benzinga Edge signal reveals a mixed, momentum-leaning profile with only moderate trend strength right now. For traders, that keeps the focus on whether this premarket bounce can reclaim nearby moving-average resistance and build a cleaner upside trend.
